title: duscope_diff
description: The arguments of duscope_diff, which runs `duscope diff OLD NEW --under PATH`.

old.description: The older saved scan: an id duscope_scan or duscope_scans gave (its first 4 or more characters will do), or latest

new.description: The newer saved scan: an id, or latest

path.description: The directory both scans hold, compared under it: absolute, or relative to the older scan's root. Default: the older scan's root, or the server's root under it

min_delta.description: Leave out growth or shrinkage smaller than this: 100M, 1.5G, 10KB, or a number of bytes. Default: 1M

depth.description: Compare the directories at this depth below the path whole

size.description: What is compared: bytes on disk (allocated, the default) or apparent length
